content: Nuna Jesus Pilate kuting te beteman
Ukiram tumong biyala priest bibiya se kari supuling suen la nongomang suan awuman mu Jesus momon se kuerukko balman.
Ale kuting kaloman, ale diruwuman ilak nama Pilate kuting te beteman. Nu Rome koma tata Judea sor ko governor.
Judas numi dogotak paogam

Judas memek te Jesus beteram se nuna momon se kuerukko balman se ikiam, mu aking ningurutala numi ko iki maguwuram, ale ko manga silver biling 30 tuman mu giam karogo peleram priest bibiya se kari supuling nongote ago namaram,
ale “Ani memek beterem! Ani kari kumik den mena wore memek te kuerukko beterem!” mam. Se nuna manorman, “Mu anananga mel mena! Mel mu nika la!” maman.
Se Judas manga iluwaram mu temple ningi waram ale aratam namaram ale mayang te numi dogotak paogam.
Se priest bibiya alo manga kaparam aniram mu giman ale balman, “Manga imi gue ago, se munan te aniso mu ana temple ko manga ago me biguwunakko,” maman.
Ale balman ale manga umu te kari kani nungurso mu kote ali bilik bo kariimet iwareng te nunga mutim tugumonko mu diaman.
Se eng am tai aitak mu ali mu ko nup “Ali Bilik Gue Ago” masan.
Se den prophet Jeremiah ko batoga te aniram mu ko nunguning kaparam. Batoga mu iwita balam: “Kari Biya iwita aga maonam, Israel kariimet manga silver biling 30 te nu diamonko balman,
ale manga umu te kani nunga ko kari kote ali bilik diaman.”
Pilate Jesus isarukaso
Jesus governor biya Pilate koma te sanamaram se Pilate nu isuam, “Ni Juda nunga king e?” mam. Se Jesus mam, “Se mu diram, ni balsam butata,” mam.
Bare priest bibiya se law ko kausa kari den te atumukasan mu nu nononga den mu ko koma me balukaso.
Aking Pilate nu isuam, “Ni den te ka atumusan wore me ikisam e?” mam.
Bare Jesus den koma bo me ta balu arigam, mu te Pilate ninguru tala ikia moakaso.
Pilate Jesus tam kangono te tagimonko balam
Rome ko munan bo mu, Passover tom taikaso mu kariimet nunga nongomang te talipara kari awiriya ko balukasan mu Pilate balukaso se nu talipara bitakaso ale aratukaso.
Se tom mu te talipara kari memek bo, kariimet ko ikia biya, ko nup Barabbas mu talipara ningi bagakaso.
Se tom kariimet tai bolala awuman mu Pilate nunga isuam, “Kari awuk bore ani kutuwu ningarikko nengemang aniso? Barabbas ko agi, kari Jesus, balsan ‘Kristus’ masan, wore ko ye?” mam.
Mu nu mungkala ko ikiam, Jesus mu duap bo te mena, am nongomang memek te ilak tai nu kuting te bita gilingiman.

Se Pilate ko den ariga ko kuwim te dagiwaram mu ko nuwus den bo beteram se kote tairam, se mam: “Ni mel bo kari kumik den mena sumu kumik te me bitarko! Ani nu kumik ko ipingira bo arigem, ale ko ikia ninguru aga moawoso,” mam.

Bare priest bibiya alo se kari supuling bibiya mu kariimet nongomang atumukasan, ale nunga manarukasan, “Nina Pilate maonal se nu Barabbas kutuwu nangaruk, ale baluk se Jesus mu momon se kuerukko,” makasan.
Se Pilate nunga isuam, “Ilagala ewere nunga ningi awuk mu ani kutuwu ningarikko?” mam, mu nuna balman, “Barabbas kutuwu nangaruko,” makasan.
Se aking Pilate nunga isuam, “Se Jesus, balsan Kristus masan, mu ani awuk bitirikko?” mam. Se nuna suen la balman, “Tam kangono te tagiralko!” makasan.
Se Pilate nunga isuam, “Nu anape memek beteram?” mam. Bare nuna am sail karogo la balukasan, “Am tam kangono te tagiralko,” makasan.

Se Pilate ikiam, mu nu mel bo bitirukko me terong iwita arigam. Ale betela nu arigam mu kariimet ningi kager biya barasukko iwita arigam. Ale kariimet biya nomotam te yu tam, ale kuting anuwam, ale balam, “Kari imi ko kumik gue ani agiting me magarukko, ani angimik den mena. Mu nenenga mel la,” mam.
Se kariimet suen la balukasan, “Mu terong, ana se nanga kuriang ago mu noko gue am nagiting magarukko,” maman.
Se Pilate Barabbas kutuwu nungaram. Ale balam, se Jesus wip te moa gilingiman, asele tam kangono te tagimonko ko kager kari nuguting te beteram.
Kager kari alo Jesus kumik ko alel munak balukasan
Se Pilate ko kager kari Jesus diruwuman ilak kawam biya mu ningi kager kari nunga bagara kuwim te ilak namaman se kager kari suen la tai biguwuman ale laturman.
Ale ko guang mu kutuwu sapaman, ale guang bo diriyam kataru tuman.

Ale mayang kore karogo mu taman ale kitigat iwita nungurman ale supuling tuguman. Ale tam bo taman, ale king ko sikir iwita kuting sengam mu te beteman. Ale koma dugu te nubugura kulukurukasan ale den dolara iwita manarukasan, “O Juda nunga king, nup biya!” makasan.
Ale kumik kuali katingikasan, ale tam kuting te mu tokasan ale gira awom la supuling te moakasan.
Nuna dolara munan umu bita sapaman ale guang diriyam mu kutuwu taman ale kota ko guang aking kataru tuman. Asele taman ale tam kangono te tagimonko ilak namakasan.
Jesus tam kangono te tagiman
Nuna diruwuman ilak nama se Cyrene kari bo
, ko nup Simon, mu arigiman, ale Jesus ko tam kangono giokko iluman ale guguna tuman.
Nuna tai kuwim bo ko nup Golgotha, ko nunguning mu “Supuling Sokel ko Sor” masan, mu te arataman.
Ale umu te, nuna waen mel seselak ago guruga mu tuikasan; se kau to arigam mu me nokaso.
Ale tom nuna tam kangono te tagiman, mu ko guang kututuwuman ale nunumi tumonko se ko kolara kola gilingikasan.
Nuna dagiman ale ari se bitaruwakasan.
Se tam kangono te kualala supuling ko mu, anapeya duap ko tam kangono te tagiman mu batagorman ale moman se anikaso. Se den mu iwita batagorman, IMI JESUS, JUDA NUNGA KING.
Se tere daong kari ilagala karogo la tam kangono te nunga tagi gilingiman, bo Jesus kuting sengam ko, se bo ko kuting ngas ko.
Se kariimet nama taikasan mu nuna ari se nusupuling sisuwuwakasan ale den dolara tuikasan,
ale makasan, “Ni temple parusuwur ale tom ilagala suan ningi aking iru kaloko balem, buta keta nimi sangaruko! Ni Kaem ko Namar agi mu, tam kangono bitar ale tai kaparko!” makasan.
Se priest bibiya, se law ko kausa kari bibiya, se kari supuling munan koma suanta te den dolara tuikasan ale balukasan,

“Nu saki alo nunga sangarukaso, bare nu kota numi sangukko me terong!” makasan. “Nu ana Israel nanga King agi mu, tam kangono bitiruk ale tai kaparuk se ana ariginak ale ko nangamang ningi nunguning arukko!” makasan.
“Nu Kaem te la ira sanami lagaram. Se Kaem gomang tuok agi mu sangukko, mu awuk, nu numi balukaso, ‘Ani Kaem ko Namar,’ makaso.”
Se tere daong kari ilagala Jesus kumik duap te nunga tagiman mu nuna karogotala den dolara memek manarukasan.
Jesus kueram
Se worem motam tai dirmam, 12 o'clock, mu worem motam tirom iluwam nama 3 o'clock, mu tiromorom ali lilim la iramuram.
Se 3 o'clock bainga ningi iwita mu Jesus sail karogo airam, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” mam, ko nunguning mu, “Aninga Kaem, aninga Kaem, ni awuk se biring gurugu aisem?”
Se kariimet saki sanamiwaman mu ikiman ale balukasan, “Mu Elijah aruso!” makasan.
Se nunga bo pasak ala naguram namaram ale mel bilik bo tam, ale waen aora seselak mu ningi mituwuram, ale tam te ko kopa te atumam ale Jesus misikirokko garukam.
Bare suen biya bagaman mu maman, “Me neger se ana Elijah tairuk sangaru taukko agi wore ariginakko,” maman.
Se Jesus akingtala sail ago niaram ale kueram.
Se temple ningi guang biya mu kualala barakam kapa kopa te paga ilagalaram. Se ali wanara ko kapakaso se manga papak maman,
se ali motam betelatala barewareng makasan ale kuring kaigakasan. Se Kaem ko kariimet suen biya kueman mu aking maragakasan
ale nunga kuera mutim bita bita aratukasan. Se udagi, tom Jesus barasam mu te, nuna wonong laili Jerusalem ningi kasu naguman se kariimet suen biya nungarkaman.

Se kager kari supuling ko kari arungak Jesus tam kangono te bitaruwaman mu, wanara kaparam se mel kasik biya aratam mu arigiman, ale ninguru nguangaman ale balukasan, “Nunguningta kakirip imi Kaem ko Namar!” makasan.
Se imet suen biya awar nuam sanamaman ale ariwakasan. Nuna Galilee la Jesus kowom karoman ale mel ko kueruk ale baluk bare te sangarmonko kowom karoman.
Imet umu nunga ningi mu Maria Magdalene, Maria bo tala, nu James se Joses nunga nunam mu se, Zebedee ko namarari mu nunga nunam agotala bagakasan.
Jesus mutim tuguman
Sor baingam taikaso se Arimathea kari bo, ko nup Joseph, nu kari kumik mel suen biya ago, nu kota mu betela Jesus ko olekem bo, mu tairam.
Nu Pilate kote namaram ale Jesus ko kumik guang taukko isuam. Se Pilate balam mu ko kumik guang mu am tumonko mam.
Se Jesus ko kumik guang tam mu kutuwu Joseph tuman se guang bo iru siraram wore te kaolam,
ale ilak nama kota ko ali motam, manga ningi pagaru nungam mu ningi beteram. Asele manga aromemek bo gurugam ale kuring te baguram, ale namaram.
Se Maria Magdalene se Maria bo tala, mu ali motam duap te dagiman ale bagakasan.
Kager kari ali motam bitarman bagakasan
Se Passover ko nunga burangara ko tom mu menaram se Sabbath duap bitawaram mu priest bibiya alo se Pharisee alo biguwuman ale Pilate kote namaman
ale, “Dom kari,” maman, “kawel kari nung mu marak baga se la iwita balukaso, ‘Ani kuerik ale tom ilagala suan mu te aking barasikko,’ makaso, ko den balam mu ana ikiman.

Buta se ni sokel karogo la balu se ali motam wore day tom ilagala suan mu ningi ninguru ko sinar tamonko. Noko olekem alo namamon kumik guang tetela la tamon ale kaluwumon ale kariimet nunga kulurmon, ale ‘nu kueram bare aking maragaram,’ mamon bore ko. Kawel nukum imitang mu nama au kaparuk ale kawel motam motam bitakaso mu am nunga kia saparukko,” maman.
Se Pilate nunga maonam, “Bitua kari sang nunga gial arungak namaral ale ali motam ninguru lautal ale ko sinar talko,” mam.
Se nuna ali motam te namaman ale te ikimonko mayang bo tareng iwita tagi beteman. Ale bitua kari nunga awuman se ko sinar bagakasan.
